text_block_list.text:
With the Classic Triple Crown under her
belt and
an impressive showing in the
Arima Kinen,
Симболи Рудольф sets her
sights on the shield of the
spring Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On returning to the waiting room, she is
greeted
by Эйр Грув, but the
vice-president seems
exhausted.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Realizing that she is the reason Air
Groove has
been running herself ragged,
Симболи Рудольф
resolves not to skimp on
her presidential duties.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As the year comes to an end, it seems
that the
pair's desire to lighten one
another's burdens is
preventing them
from seeing eye to eye.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
